## Coinbase - Senior Software Engineer, Backend – Overseer

🔗 [Apply](https://boards.greenhouse.io/coinbase/jobs/8238630)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior backend engineer building Coinbase’s real-time integrity layer for financial fund flows. Designing invariant enforcement, AI-powered guardrails, and distributed systems that protect transaction accuracy.
Senior backend engineer building Coinbase’s real-time financial integrity infrastructure
- Salary: $186,065 - $218,900 per year
- Tech stack: Distributed Systems, DynamoDB, Kafka, Postgres, Python, Ruby, Spark, Go
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors H1B visas. Treat as a small scoring bonus, not a guarantee for this role.
- Build and scale real-time invariant enforcement systems across Coinbase's fund flows
- Contribute to the core detection engine, invariant framework, and onboarding tooling
- Own workstreams end-to-end, from designing correctness models with partner teams through production operation
- Ensure new fund flows are covered by Overseer's integrity guarantees
- Develop AI-powered guardrails, including predictive consistency models and proactive invariant discovery
- Partner with FinHub, Payments, and Trading teams to design and implement correctness contracts
- Translate financial rules into enforceable system invariants
- Mentor junior engineers on distributed systems design, correctness thinking, and production operational practices
- 5+ years building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production
- Experience in financial systems, payments, reconciliation, or high-reliability transactional infrastructure
- Proficiency in backend programming, such as Go, Ruby, or Python
- Experience building platform-level infrastructure consumed by multiple teams, including APIs, frameworks, or detection systems
- Ability to own workstreams end-to-end in ambiguous environments
- Experience designing correctness models and operating them through production
- Experience with streaming data infrastructure such as Kafka, Flink, Spark, or similar
- Experience with distributed data stores such as Postgres, DynamoDB, or equivalent

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior backend engineer building Coinbase’s real-time integrity layer for financial fund flows. Designing invariant enforcement, AI-powered guardrails, and distributed systems that protect transaction accuracy.
Senior backend engineer building Coinbase’s real-time financial integrity infrastructure
Role description:
• Build and scale real-time invariant enforcement systems across Coinbase's fund flows
• Contribute to the core detection engine, invariant framework, and onboarding tooling
• Own workstreams end-to-end, from designing correctness models with partner teams through production operation
• Ensure new fund flows are covered by Overseer's integrity guarantees
• Develop AI-powered guardrails, including predictive consistency models and proactive invariant discovery
• Partner with FinHub, Payments, and Trading teams to design and implement correctness contracts
• Translate financial rules into enforceable system invariants
• Mentor junior engineers on distributed systems design, correctness thinking, and production operational practices
Role requirements:
• 5+ years building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production
• Experience in financial systems, payments, reconciliation, or high-reliability transactional infrastructure
• Proficiency in backend programming, such as Go, Ruby, or Python
• Experience building platform-level infrastructure consumed by multiple teams, including APIs, frameworks, or detection systems
• Ability to own workstreams end-to-end in ambiguous environments
• Experience designing correctness models and operating them through production
• Experience with streaming data infrastructure such as Kafka, Flink, Spark, or similar
• Experience with distributed data stores such as Postgres, DynamoDB, or equivalent
• Experience in real-time or near-real-time processing contexts
• Responsible use of generative AI with human oversight
• Eligible to work in the United States
Benefits:
• Equity eligibility
• Bonus eligibility
• Medical insurance
• Dental insurance
• Vision insurance

• Quarterly in-person working sessions called “surges”

Distributed Systems, DynamoDB, Kafka, Postgres, Python, Ruby, Spark, Go
